start = randint(0, 5)
stop = start + randint(6, 15)
step = choice([1, 2, 3])
acc = choice(["s", "total", "somme", "res"])
op = choice(["+", "*"]) if stop - start < 8 and step > 1 else "+"
init = 0 if op == "+" else 1
src = f"{acc} = {init}\nfor i in range({start}, {stop}, {step}):\n    {acc} = {acc} {op} i\nprint({acc})"
if op == "*":
    src = src.replace(f"range({start}", f"range({max(start, 1)}")
out = run(src)
vals = list(range(max(start, 1) if op == "*" else start, stop, step))
